newsitem.title: USA: Burlington Northern sees 97 revs growth.
newsitem.headline: Burlington Northern sees 97 revs growth.

text.p: Burlington Northern Santa Fe Corp has set a 1997 revenue growth target of six percent over 1996's $8.19 billion, said Rob Krebs, chief executive officer and president.
At an analysts' meeting on Tuesday, Krebs said the six percent revenue growth target was "aggressive in light of the current situation, but that doesn't mean we can't make it."
The company reported fourth quarter earnings of $1.56 per share compared with a reported loss of $1.19 per share in 1995's fourth quarter.
Burlington Northern has targeted capital spending of $1.85 billion in 1997, compared with $2.23 billion in 1996, said Denis Springer, the company's chief financial officer.
